publication.title: Efficient Self-Supervised Adaptation of 3D Abdominal Vision-Language Model for Institution-Specific HCC Classification via Full Fine-Tuning and PEFT

sources.primary_authority: The accepted paper takes precedence when its reported experiment values conflict with repository launch defaults.
sources.conflict_note: At the audited commit, main.sh launches full tuning at 1e-4, while the accepted paper explicitly reports and justifies 1e-5. The launcher also passes --tuning although config.py accepts --tuning_mode, and its filename says noWD while train.py applies 0.01 weight decay. This profile gives the accepted paper priority for reported values and uses train.py for settings absent from the paper.

paper_exact.encoder_lr: Appendix C, Table 6 and accompanying text: full fine-tuning learning rate 1e-5.
paper_exact.early_stopping_patience: Appendix C, Table 6: 5, selected by validation F1.
paper_exact.min_lr_factor: Appendix C: cosine learning-rate decay to zero.
paper_exact.gradient_checkpointing: Appendix C: enabled for image and text encoders.

official_code_backed.encoder_weight_decay: train.py passes weight_decay=0.01; exclusions and LLDR in the source implementation are not fully reproduced by this classifier optimizer.
official_code_backed.warmup_epochs: train.py calls the scheduler with warmup_steps=0.
official_code_backed.max_grad_norm: The audited training loop performs no gradient clipping; zero disables clipping here.

supervised_classifier_adaptations.head_lr: The publication has projection layers rather than this classifier head; the publication base learning rate is used.
supervised_classifier_adaptations.dropout_prob: The publication has no equivalent classifier dropout; zero avoids adding publication-unsupported dropout.
supervised_classifier_adaptations.head_weight_decay: The official code applies 0.01 to eligible projection matrices; the same value is adapted to this classifier head.
supervised_classifier_adaptations.min_delta: The official code uses strict F1 improvement, represented as zero.
supervised_classifier_adaptations.embedding_dim: The classifier input follows Merlin's 2048-dimensional image representation.

known_methodological_differences: The publication fully tunes both image and text encoders using joint image-text InfoNCE; this project fully tunes only the image encoder for supervised multiclass classification.
The publication learns contrastive temperature and evaluates initial values 0.07, 0.5, 1.0, and 10.0; this classifier has no temperature parameter.
The official code uses layer-wise learning-rate decay of 0.7 and steps its scheduler per minibatch; the current classifier uses two optimizer groups and steps its scheduler per epoch.
The official code excludes normalization parameters and biases from weight decay; the current classifier optimizer applies weight decay per encoder/head group.
The publication stops on validation F1 alone; this project selects and stops on 0.7*macro-F1 + 0.3*balanced accuracy.

The official code accumulates unscaled minibatch losses and does not flush a partial accumulation at the epoch boundary; this project divides loss by the accumulation count and flushes the final partial accumulation.
The publication uses FP16 mixed precision. Supply --amp to match that runtime setting.
